traditional: 搞到 A 睇嘢矇晒
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A tai2 je5 mung4 saai3

english.note: Use this when glare or another cause makes someone's vision blurry or dim.

examples.english: Those headlights made everything in front of me blur.
examples.traditional: 對車頭燈搞到我睇嘢矇晒。
examples.jyutping: deoi3 ce1 tau4 dang1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tai2 je5 mung4 saai3
